what: Bentley Systems writes the software engineers use to design and operate infrastructure: bridges, roads, water networks, power grids and plants, including the MicroStation drafting system and the iTwin digital twin platform.
customers: Civil engineering firms, construction companies and the public agencies that own infrastructure.
money: design and operations software licensed by seat and by use
moat: Engineering drawings and models made in Bentley software stay in Bentley formats for the life of the asset, and infrastructure assets last decades. That makes switching nearly unthinkable once a firm has standardised.
risks: 42 times earnings and 7.8 times sales, a price that needs continued growth
Revenue depends on infrastructure spending, which is set by government budgets
The Schwarzman and founding family holdings mean the free float is limited
opportunities: A 18.5% net margin and $489M of free cash flow on $1.6B of revenue
Revenue grew from $965M to $1.5B in four years, almost all of it recurring
Infrastructure programmes in the United States and Europe are funded for years ahead
watch: Annual recurring revenue growth and account retention.
